The '''Zygerrian ''Freighter''-class vessel''' was a class of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] used by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]]. The ''[[Fate's Hand]]'' was a member of this [[Starship/Legends|starship]] class.
